rows.label: Income tax: French income tax does not apply after five years' residence
rows.value: Saint-Barthélemy has its own tax powers: French income tax does not extend to it, except for people who have had their tax domicile there for less than five years (CGCT art. LO 6214-4), who remain taxable in France. The Code des contributions levies no general income tax.
